name: @fluid-design-system/tokens
description: Fluid Design System - 3-Tier Design Token Architecture (Tier 1 Primitives & Tier 2 Semantics)

scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['colors','typography','spacing','radius','border','index'].forEach(f=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('tokens/tier-1-primitives/'+f+'.json'))); ['colors-light','colors-dark','layout','typography','index'].forEach(f=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('tokens/tier-2-semantic/'+f+'.json'))); console.log('All Tier 1 and Tier 2 JSON tokens valid.');"

author: Fluid Design System Team
